title: mindwalk judge progress
description: Step-level update emitted during an evaluation run and streamed to the browser via Server-Sent Events. The frontend opens an EventSource that receives 'progress' events (one per judge milestone) followed by a terminal 'status' event. Each SSE event also carries an 'id:' line (the zero-based event index in the progress log) so a dropped connection can resume from Last-Event-ID without replaying duplicates.

phase.description: The coarse pipeline stage: 'start' is the initial event every run emits; 'rubric' covers task-rubric generation or reuse; 'scoring' is the unified scoring pass; 'done' signals completion; 'error' signals failure

step.description: Qualifies the phase: 'skip' (rubric deterministically skipped), 'reuse' (cached rubric reused), 'generate' (rubric being drafted), 'complete' (phase finished), 'retry' (scoring retrying), 'fail' (phase failed). Omitted when the phase needs no sub-step

message.description: Human-readable description safe to show as-is in the evaluation progress panel
